qc.label_under_test: the bare capital piece 'Str' when a word is not space-prefixed (after a quote, hyphen or line break), and the '-sr-' piece in German -srat compounds

neighbours.label: a glued-on, unfinished word chunk ending in 'r' with no space before it: the bare piece 'Str' (after a quote, hyphen or line break, e.g. "Str|ategie"), 'sr' in German -srat compounds (Vorstand|sr|at), '-R' after a hyphen (Top-R|uf), 'str' in 'Substrat'; not the space-prefixed ' Str' or whole words like 'Strand'
